items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes etaleness of a morphism of algebraic stacks through an etale presentation over a smooth cover of the base (author lemma at source lines 8538-8548, label lemma-characterize-etale). The proof (source lines 8550-8567) uses the unramified characterization for one equivalence, produces the etale presentation from the DM characterization and reduces to the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 8550-8566). The construction of the presentation and the reduction are the substance. H3.
